rows.grounds: Compound describing the goddess as possessing enclosures made of molten gold; analyzed as a fused attributive form.
Compound describing the goddess as wearing sandals made of molten gold; analyzed as a fused attributive form.

items.question: By what molten-gold enclosures and footwear is the goddess characterized?
premises: The goddess is described as having ramparts of molten gold.
The goddess is described as having sandals of molten gold.
items.inference: The goddess is characterized by molten-gold attributes associated with both her surrounding enclosure and her feet.
uncertainties: Whether prākārā refers to a literal architectural rampart or a symbolic protective boundary is not specified.
items.plain_english: She has ramparts of molten gold and sandals of molten gold.
